title: ConsisVLA-4D: Advancing Spatiotemporal Consistency in Efficient 3D-Perception and 4D-Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on mapping 2D observations to actions, but exhibit notable limitations in spatiotemporal perception and reasoning: 1) spatial representations often rely on additional sensors, introducing substantial computational overhead; 2) visual reasoning is typically limited to future-frame prediction, lacking alignment with the instruction-grounded scene and thus compromising spatiotemporal consistency. To address these challenges, we propose ConsisVLA-4D, a unified and efficient framework that enhances spatiotemporal consistency in 3D perception and 4D reasoning. Specifically, we design: 1) CV-Aligner, which ensures cross-view object semantic consistency by filtering instruction-relevant regions and aligning object identities across multiple viewpoints; 2) CO-Fuser, which guarantees cross-object spatial geometric consistency by eliminating spatial relation ambiguities between objects across views using compact latent representations. Building upon these, we introduce 3) CS-Thinker to achieve cross-scene spatiotemporal consistency as actions unfold. It learns implicit knowledge of local dynamics from object-semantic tokens of CV-Aligner and global depth from geometric tokens of CO-Fuser, thereby enhancing efficient visual reasoning under scene variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, benefiting from its efficient spatiotemporal consistency design, ConsisVLA-4D achieves 21.6% and 41.5% performance improvements, along with 2.3-fold and 2.4-fold inference speedups compared to OpenVLA on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world platforms, respectively.ConsisVLA-4D is open-sourced and publicly available at
tldr: Proposes ConsisVLA-4D, a VLA framework for robotic manipulation that enhances spatiotemporal consistency in 3D perception and 4D reasoning through cross-view alignment, cross-object geometric fusion, and cross-scene reasoning modules.
tldr_zh: 提出ConsisVLA-4D，一种用于机器人操作的VLA框架，通过跨视图对齐、跨对象几何融合和跨场景推理模块，提升了3D感知和4D推理中的时空一致性。
summary_zh: 当前的视觉-语言-动作模型主要专注于将二维观测映射到动作，但在时空感知与推理方面存在明显局限：1）空间表示通常依赖附加传感器，引入大量计算开销；2）视觉推理往往局限于未来帧预测，缺乏与指令接地场景的对齐，从而损害时空一致性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出ConsisVLA-4D——一个统一高效、能增强三维感知与四维推理时空一致性的框架。具体而言，我们设计：1）CV-Aligner通过过滤指令相关区域并跨多视角对齐物体身份，确保跨视图物体语义一致性；2）CO-Fuser利用紧凑潜在表征消除跨视图物体间的空间关系歧义，保障跨物体空间几何一致性。在此基础上，我们引入3）CS-Thinker以实现动作展开过程中的跨场景时空一致性。该模块从CV-Aligner的物体语义标记中学习局部动态隐式知识，并从CO-Fuser的几何标记中获取全局深度信息，从而增强场景变化下的高效视觉推理能力。大量实验表明，受益于其高效的时空一致性设计，ConsisVLA-4D在LIBERO基准测试和真实世界平台上相比OpenVLA分别实现了21.6%和41.5%的性能提升，以及2.3倍和2.4倍的推理加速。ConsisVLA-4D已开源并公开于指定网址。

title: Driver-WM: A Driver-Centric Traffic-Conditioned Latent World Model for In-Cabin Dynamics Rollout
summary: Safe L2/L3 driving automation requires anticipating human-in-the-loop reactions during shared-control transitions. While most driving world models forecast the external environment, in-cabin intelligence remains strictly recognition-oriented and lacks multi-step rollout capabilities for driver dynamics. We introduce Driver-WM, a driver-centric latent world model that rolls out in-cabin dynamics causally conditioned on out-cabin traffic context. This formulation unifies physical kinematics forecasting with auxiliary behavioral and emotional semantic recognition. Operating in a compact latent space constructed from frozen vision-language features, Driver-WM adopts a dual-stream architecture to separately encode external traffic and internal driver states. These streams are directionally coupled via a gated causal injection mechanism, which uses a learned vector gate to modulate external contextual perturbations while strictly enforcing temporal causality. Evaluations on a multi-task assistive driving benchmark demonstrate that Driver-WM yields robust long-horizon geometric forecasting for reactive high-motion maneuvers and improves semantic alignment for both driver and traffic states. Finally, the explicit external-to-internal conditioning allows for controlled test-time interventions to systematically analyze mechanism responses.
tldr: The paper introduces Driver-WM, a driver-centric latent world model that causally rolls out in-cabin dynamics conditioned on external traffic context, unifying geometric forecasting with semantic recognition.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Driver-WM，一个以驾驶员为中心的潜在世界模型，它以外部的交通状况为因果条件，对舱内动态进行推演，将几何预测与语义识别相统一。
summary_zh: L2/L3级安全驾驶自动化需在共享控制权转移过程中预测"人在回路"的反应。当前大多数驾驶世界模型仅能预测外部环境，而车内智能系统仍严格局限于识别功能，缺乏对驾驶员动态行为的多步推演能力。本文提出Driver-WM——一种以驾驶员为中心的隐式世界模型，该模型能够根据车外交通场景的因果条件推演车内动态。该框架将物理运动学预测与辅助性行为及情感语义识别相统一。Driver-WM在基于冻结视觉语言特征构建的紧凑隐空间内运行，采用双流架构分别编码外部交通状态与内部驾驶员状态，并通过门控因果注入机制实现定向耦合：该机制利用学习型向量门控调节外部情境扰动，同时严格遵循时间因果律。在多任务辅助驾驶基准测试中，Driver-WM针对反应性高机动动作表现出稳健的长时域几何预测能力，并提升了驾驶员与交通状态的语义对齐度。最后，显式的外部-内部条件控制机制支持受控的测试时干预，可用于系统性分析模型机理响应。

title: ELVIS: Ensemble-Calibrated Latent Imagination for Long-Horizon Visual MPC
summary: A central challenge of visual control with model-based reinforcement learning (RL) is reliable long-horizon planning: long rollouts with learned latent dynamics exhibit branching futures and multi-modal action-value distributions. In addition, compounding model errors amplified by visual occlusions make deep imagination brittle. We present ELVIS, a latent model predictive controller (MPC) designed to make long-horizon planning practical. ELVIS plans in a Dreamer-style recurrent state space model (RSSM) and replaces standard unimodal model predictive path integral (MPPI) with a Gaussian-mixture MPPI that maintains multiple coherent hypotheses over long horizons, avoiding mode averaging under branching rollouts. In parallel, ELVIS stabilizes deep imagination with a shared uncertainty-aware lambda-return: an ensemble of latent critics defines an upper-confidence-bound (UCB) score that gates a time-varying lambda, adaptively trading off bootstrapping versus look-ahead to limit compounding error during planning. The same return is used both to train an actor-critic prior from imagined rollouts and to score candidate trajectories inside GMM-MPPI, aligning RL objectives with the planner's long-horizon optimization. On fourteen DeepMind Control Suite visual tasks, ELVIS establishes state-of-the-art performance compared with TD-MPC2 and DreamerV3. Finally, ELVIS transfers zero-shot to a real-world sand-spraying task with severe occlusions, improving surface-quality metrics and demonstrating robustness beyond simulation.
tldr: ELVIS introduces a latent MPC method that uses a Gaussian-mixture MPPI for long-horizon planning in visual control tasks, coupled with an ensemble-calibrated return to mitigate compounding model error, achieving state-of-the-art performance in simulation and real-world transfer.
tldr_zh: ELVIS 提出了一种潜在 MPC 方法，使用高斯混合 MPPI 进行视觉控制任务中的长时域规划，并利用集成校准回报来减轻复合模型误差，在仿真和真实世界转移中实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（RL）视觉控制的核心挑战是实现可靠的长时程规划：使用学习到的潜在动力学进行长时程推演时，会面临未来路径的分支化和动作价值分布的多模态性。此外，视觉遮挡导致的模型误差累积进一步加剧了深度想象的脆弱性。本文提出ELVIS——一种专为实用化长时程规划设计的潜在模型预测控制器（MPC）。ELVIS在Dreamer式循环状态空间模型（RSSM）中进行规划，采用高斯混合模型预测路径积分（GMM-MPPI）替代传统单模态MPPI，通过维护长时程中多个连贯的假设来避免分支推演下的模态平均问题。同时，ELVIS通过共享的不确定性感知λ回报机制来稳定深度想象：潜在评价器集合定义了上置信界（UCB）评分，该评分通过门控时变λ参数，自适应调整自助法与前瞻策略的权衡，从而限制规划过程中的误差累积。该回报机制既用于从想象推演中训练行动者-评价器先验，也用于在GMM-MPPI内评估候选轨迹，实现了RL目标与规划器长时程优化的对齐。在DeepMind控制套件的十四个视觉任务上，ELVIS相比TD-MPC2和DreamerV3取得了最先进的性能。最后，ELVIS在具有严重遮挡的真实世界沙粒喷洒任务中实现了零样本迁移，通过提升表面质量指标证明了其在仿真环境之外的鲁棒性。

title: ReflectDrive-2: Reinforcement-Learning-Aligned Self-Editing for Discrete Diffusion Driving
summary: We introduce ReflectDrive-2, a masked discrete diffusion planner with separate action expert for autonomous driving that represents plans as discrete trajectory tokens and generates them through parallel masked decoding. This discrete token space enables in-place trajectory revision: AutoEdit rewrites selected tokens using the same model, without requiring an auxiliary refinement network. To train this capability, we use a two-stage procedure. First, we construct structure-aware perturbations of expert trajectories along longitudinal progress and lateral heading directions and supervise the model to recover the original expert trajectory. We then fine-tune the full decision--draft--reflect rollout with reinforcement learning (RL), assigning terminal driving reward to the final post-edit trajectory and propagating policy-gradient credit through full-rollout transitions. Full-rollout RL proves crucial for coupling drafting and editing: under supervised training alone, inference-time AutoEdit improves PDMS by at most $0.3$, whereas RL increases its gain to $1.9$. We also co-design an efficient reflective decoding stack for the decision--draft--reflect pipeline, combining shared-prefix KV reuse, Alternating Step Decode, and fused on-device unmasking. On NAVSIM, ReflectDrive-2 achieves $91.0$ PDMS with camera-only input and $94.8$ PDMS in a best-of-6 oracle setting, while running at $31.8$ ms average latency on NVIDIA Thor.
tldr: The paper introduces ReflectDrive-2, a reinforcement-learning-aligned discrete diffusion model for autonomous driving that uses in-place trajectory editing and full-rollout RL to improve planning performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ReflectDrive-2，一种用于自动驾驶的强化学习对齐的离散扩散模型，通过原地轨迹编辑和全轮次强化学习来提升规划性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出ReflectDrive-2，这是一种用于自动驾驶的掩码离散扩散规划器，配备独立动作专家模块，将规划表示为离散轨迹令牌并通过并行掩码解码生成。这一离散令牌空间实现了原位轨迹修订：AutoEdit功能可利用同一模型重写选定令牌，无需辅助优化网络。为训练此能力，我们采用两阶段训练流程：首先沿纵向进程与横向航向构建专家轨迹的结构感知扰动，并监督模型恢复原始专家轨迹；随后通过强化学习对完整的"决策—草拟—反思"推演流程进行微调，将最终驾驶奖励分配给编辑后的轨迹，并通过全流程转移传播策略梯度权重。全流程强化学习被证明对耦合草拟与编辑至关重要：在纯监督训练下，推理时AutoEdit仅能将PDMS提升最多0.3分，而强化学习可将其增益提升至1.9分。我们还为"决策—草拟—反思"流水线协同设计了高效反射解码架构，结合共享前缀KV缓存复用、交替步进解码与融合设备端掩码解除技术。在NAVSIM基准测试中，ReflectDrive-2在仅使用摄像头输入时达到91.0 PDMS，在六选一先知设置下达到94.8 PDMS，在NVIDIA Thor平台上的平均延迟为31.8毫秒。

title: Active Contact Sensing for Robust Robot-to-Human Object Handover
summary: Robot-to-human object handover is an essential skill for robot assistants, from serving drinks at home to passing surgical tools in the operating room. We expect robots to perform handover robustly -- to release the object only after a firm human grasp while ignoring incidental touches. Existing passive-sensing methods struggle to generalize across diverse objects and human behaviors, as they lack informative perturbations to disambiguate different contact conditions, such as firm grasp versus incidental touch. We propose an active sensing approach for robust handovers: the robot applies information-gathering motions and senses the resulting human-applied forces to infer the contact state. A firm grasp produces forces in multiple directions, while an accidental touch does not. To capture this distinction, we model the contact state with a Bayesian linear model: a distribution over piecewise-linear mappings from robot motions to human-applied forces. This model enables firm grasp detection and active information gathering. In experiments with 12 participants and 30 diverse rigid objects, our method achieved a 97.5% success rate -- over 30% higher than two common baselines.
tldr: The paper proposes an active contact sensing method for robust robot-to-human object handover, using information-gathering motions and a Bayesian linear model to infer firm grasp vs. incidental touch.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于鲁棒的机器人向人传递物体的主动接触感知方法，通过信息采集动作和贝叶斯线性模型来推断牢固抓握与偶然接触。
summary_zh: 机器人向人类传递物品是机器人助手的一项关键技能，从家庭中的饮料递送到手术室中传递手术工具皆需此能力。我们期望机器人能够稳健地完成物品传递——仅当人类牢固抓握后才释放物体，同时忽略偶发性的触碰。现有被动传感方法难以在不同物体和人类行为中实现泛化，因为它们缺乏信息丰富的扰动来区分不同的接触状态，例如牢固抓握与偶发触碰。我们提出一种用于稳健传递的主动传感方法：机器人执行信息收集运动，并感知由此产生的人类施加力以推断接触状态。牢固抓握会在多个方向产生作用力，而偶然触碰则不会。为捕捉这种差异，我们采用贝叶斯线性模型对接触状态进行建模：该模型建立了从机器人运动到人类施加力的分段线性映射的概率分布。该模型既能实现牢固抓握检测，又能支持主动信息收集。在12名参与者和30种不同刚性物体的实验中，我们的方法实现了97.5%的成功率——较两种常见基线方法提升超过30%。

title: CRAFT: Counterfactual-to-Interactive Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Driving Policies
summary: Open-loop imitation learning has advanced modern autonomous driving policy architectures, but closed-loop deployment remains vulnerable to policy-induced distribution shift. Existing post-training paradigms exhibit fundamental trade-offs: closed-loop RL fine-tuning provides grounded feedback from executed actions but is constrained by the sparsity of informative events, whereas counterfactual fine-tuning provides dense supervision over candidate futures but inherits bias from imperfect future estimates. We introduce Counterfactual-to-Interactive Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (CRAFT), an on-policy framework that formulates closed-loop post-training as proxy-residual optimization. CRAFT uses group-normalized counterfactual advantages as a dense proxy for real closed-loop advantages and aligns this proxy with the closed-loop world through grounded residual correction from interaction-critical events. To stabilize adaptation, CRAFT regularizes the online policy toward an EMA teacher via asymmetric KL self-distillation. Theoretically, CRAFT decomposes the real closed-loop policy gradient into proxy and residual terms under the same visited-state distribution, reducing residual variance with an aligned proxy while mitigating proxy bias through grounded residual approximation. Empirically, CRAFT achieves the strongest closed-loop gains on Bench2Drive across hierarchical planning, vision-language-action, and vocabulary-scoring architectures. Ablations, scaling behavior, stability analyses, and transfer results further validate the complementary roles of dense counterfactual proxy and grounded residual correction. Project page: https://currychen77.github.io/CRAFT.
tldr: CRAFT introduces a counterfactual-to-interactive reinforcement fine-tuning framework for driving policies, combining dense counterfactual advantages with grounded residual correction to improve closed-loop performance.
tldr_zh: CRAFT提出了一种用于驾驶策略的反事实到交互式强化微调框架，结合密集的反事实优势与接地的残差校正，以提高闭环性能。
summary_zh: 开环模仿学习推动了现代自动驾驶策略架构的发展，但闭环部署仍易受策略引发的分布偏移影响。现有后训练范式存在本质权衡：闭环强化学习微调通过执行动作提供真实反馈，但受限于信息性事件的稀疏性；而反事实微调虽能对候选未来状态提供密集监督，却继承了不完美未来估计的偏差。本文提出反事实交互式强化微调框架，通过代理-残差优化将闭环后训练形式化。该框架使用分组归一化的反事实优势作为真实闭环优势的密集代理，并利用交互关键事件的真实残差校正将代理与闭环世界对齐。为提升自适应稳定性，框架通过非对称KL自蒸馏将在线策略向指数移动平均教师模型正则化。理论上，该框架在相同访问状态分布下将真实闭环策略梯度分解为代理项与残差项，通过对齐代理降低残差方差，同时借助真实残差逼近缓解代理偏差。实验表明，该框架在分层规划、视觉-语言-动作与词汇评分架构上均取得最优的闭环性能增益。消融研究、规模扩展行为、稳定性分析及迁移结果进一步验证了密集反事实代理与真实残差校正的互补作用。项目页面：https://currychen77.github.io/CRAFT。

title: When Life Gives You BC, Make Q-functions: Extracting Q-values from Behavior Cloning for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Behavior Cloning (BC) has emerged as a highly effective paradigm for robot learning. However, BC lacks a self-guided mechanism for online improvement after demonstrations have been collected. Existing offline-to-online learning methods often cause policies to replace previously learned good actions due to a distribution mismatch between offline data and online learning. In this work, we propose Q2RL, Q-Estimation and Q-Gating from BC for Reinforcement Learning, an algorithm for efficient offline-to-online learning. Our method consists of two parts: (1) Q-Estimation extracts a Q-function from a BC policy using a few interaction steps with the environment, followed by online RL with (2) Q-Gating, which switches between BC and RL policy actions based on their respective Q-values to collect samples for RL policy training. Across manipulation tasks from D4RL and robomimic benchmarks, Q2RL outperforms SOTA offline-to-online learning baselines on success rate and time to convergence. Q2RL is efficient enough to be applied in an on-robot RL setting, learning robust policies for contact-rich and high precision manipulation tasks such as pipe assembly and kitting, in 1-2 hours of online interaction, achieving success rates of up to 100% and up to 3.75x improvement against the original BC policy. Code and video are available at https://pages.rai-inst.com/q2rl_website/
tldr: Proposes Q2RL, a method to extract Q-values from a BC policy for efficient offline-to-online RL, enabling rapid on-robot policy improvement for manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出 Q2RL 方法，从行为克隆策略中提取 Q 值，用于高效的离线到在线强化学习，实现机器人在操控任务上的快速策略改进。
summary_zh: 行为克隆（BC）已成为机器人学习领域一种高效范式。然而，BC缺乏在演示数据收集后进行自主在线改进的机制。现有离线到在线学习方法常因离线数据与在线学习间的分布不匹配，导致策略替换先前习得的优质动作。本文提出Q2RL算法——基于BC的Q估计与Q门控强化学习，以实现高效的离线到在线学习。该方法包含两部分：（1）Q估计通过与环境的少量交互步从BC策略中提取Q函数，（2）Q门控根据BC与RL策略动作的各自Q值进行切换，为RL策略训练收集样本。在D4RL和robomimic基准测试的多个操作任务中，Q2RL在成功率和收敛速度上均优于当前最先进的离线到在线学习基线。Q2RL具有足够高效性，可应用于机器人实时强化学习场景，仅需1-2小时在线交互即可学习接触密集型高精度操作任务（如管道装配与零件组装）的鲁棒策略，成功率最高达100%，较原始BC策略提升高达3.75倍。代码与视频详见https://pages.rai-inst.com/q2rl_website/

title: LineRides: Line-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Bicycle Robot Stunts
summary: Designing reward functions for agile robotic maneuvers in reinforcement learning remains difficult, and demonstration-based approaches often require reference motions that are unavailable for novel platforms or extreme stunts. We present LineRides, a line-guided learning framework that enables a custom bicycle robot to acquire diverse, commandable stunt behaviors from a user-provided spatial guideline and sparse key-orientations, without demonstrations or explicit timing. LineRides handles physically infeasible guidelines using a tracking margin that permits controlled deviation, resolves temporal ambiguity by measuring progress via traveled distance along the guideline, and disambiguates motion details through position- and sequence-based key-orientations. We evaluate LineRides on the Ultra Mobility Vehicle (UMV) and show that the policy trained with our methods supports seamless transitions between normal driving and stunt execution, enabling five distinct stunts on command: MiniHop, LargeHop, ThreePointTurn, Backflip, and DriftTurn.
tldr: LineRides is a line-guided RL framework that enables a custom bicycle robot to learn diverse stunt behaviors from a spatial guideline and sparse key-orientations, without demonstrations, supporting seamless transitions between driving and stunts.
tldr_zh: LineRides是一个线引导的强化学习框架，使定制自行车机器人能够从用户提供的空间指南和稀疏关键方向中学习多样的特技动作，无需演示，支持驾驶与特技之间的无缝切换。
summary_zh: 在强化学习中，为敏捷机器人机动设计奖励函数仍然存在困难，而基于演示的方法通常需要参考动作，这对新平台或极限特技来说往往难以获取。我们提出了LineRides——一个基于线路引导的学习框架，使定制自行车机器人能够通过用户提供的空间引导线和稀疏关键姿态，无需演示或显式时间规划即可习得多样化的可操控特技行为。LineRides通过允许可控偏离的跟踪容差来处理物理上不可行的引导线，通过沿引导线的行进距离衡量进度以解决时间模糊性，并基于位置和序列的关键姿态来明确运动细节。我们在超机动车辆（UMV）上对LineRides进行了评估，结果表明，采用我们的方法训练出的策略支持在正常行驶与特技执行之间无缝切换，能够按指令完成五种不同特技：MiniHop（小跳）、LargeHop（大跳）、ThreePointTurn（三点转向）、Backflip（后空翻）和DriftTurn（漂移转向）。

title: Reduced-order Neural Modeling with Differentiable Simulation for High-Detail Tactile Perception
summary: Tactile perception is key to dexterous manipulation, yet simulating high-resolution elastomer deformation remains computationally prohibitive. Finite element methods (FEM) deliver high fidelity but demand costly remeshing, while Material Point Methods (MPM) suffer from heavy particle-memory tradeoffs. We propose a {reduced-order neural simulation framework} that couples coarse-grained MPM dynamics with an implicit neural decoder to reconstruct sub-particle tactile details from compact latent states. The framework learns a continuous deformation manifold from paired high- and low-resolution simulations, enabling physically consistent, differentiable inference. Compared to the TacIPC, our method achieves over 65\% faster simulation and {40\% lower memory usage}, while maintaining better geometric fidelity. In tactile rendering and 3D surface reconstruction, our methods further improve accuracy by 25\% and produce realistic depth images and surface mesh within a faster inference speed. These results demonstrate that the proposed reduced-order neural model enables high-detail, physically grounded tactile simulation with substantial efficiency gains for robotic interaction and optimization.
tldr: The paper proposes a reduced-order neural simulation framework that couples coarse-grained MPM with an implicit neural decoder to enable high-detail, physically grounded, and efficient tactile simulation for robotic interaction and optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种降阶神经模拟框架，将粗粒度MPM与隐式神经解码器耦合，以实现高细节、物理真实且高效触觉模拟，服务于机器人交互与优化。
summary_zh: 触觉感知是灵巧操作的关键，但模拟高分辨率弹性体变形在计算上仍面临巨大挑战。有限元方法（FEM）能够提供高保真度仿真，但需要昂贵的网格重建成本；而物质点法（MPM）则存在粒子与内存开销的权衡问题。我们提出一种**降阶神经仿真框架**，将粗粒度MPM动力学与隐式神经解码器耦合，从紧凑的潜态中重建亚粒子级别的触觉细节。该框架通过配对的高分辨率与低分辨率仿真数据学习连续变形流形，实现了物理一致且可微分的推理。相较于TacIPC，我们的方法在保持更优几何保真度的同时，实现了超过65%的仿真速度提升和**40%的内存占用降低**。在触觉渲染与三维表面重建任务中，我们的方法进一步将精度提升25%，并以更快的推理速度生成逼真的深度图像与表面网格。这些结果表明，所提出的降阶神经模型能够实现高细节、物理真实的触觉仿真，为机器人交互与优化任务带来显著的效率提升。

title: Modular Reinforcement Learning For Cooperative Swarms
summary: A cooperative robot swarm is a collective of computationally-limited robots that share a common goal. Each robot can only interact with a small subset of its peers, without knowing how this affects the collective utility. Recent advances in distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning have demonstrated that it is possible for robots to learn how to interact effectively with others, in a manner that is aligned with the common goal, despite each robot learning independently of others. However, this requires each robot to represent a potentially combinatorial number of interaction states, challenging the memory capabilities of the robots. This paper proposes an alternative approach for representing spatial interaction states for multi-robot reinforcement learning in swarms. A modular (decomposed) representation is used, where each feature of the state is handled by a separate learning procedure, and the results aggregated. We demonstrate the efficacy of the approach in numerous experiments with simulated robot swarms carrying out foraging.
tldr: This paper proposes a modular (decomposed) state representation for distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning in computationally-limited robot swarms, aiming to reduce the memory burden of representing combinatorial interaction states.
tldr_zh: 本文为计算能力有限的机器人群体中的分布式多智能体强化学习提出了一种模块化（分解）的状态表示方法，旨在减少表示组合交互状态的内存负担。
summary_zh: 协作式机器人群体是由一群计算能力有限的机器人组成，它们共享一个共同的目标。每个机器人只能与一小部分同伴进行交互，而不知道这如何影响整体的效用。分布式多智能体强化学习的最新进展表明，尽管每个机器人独立于其他机器人学习，但它们仍有可能学会如何以与共同目标一致的方式有效地与其他机器人交互。然而，这要求每个机器人能够表示潜在组合数量的交互状态，这对机器人的记忆能力提出了挑战。本文提出了一种替代方法，用于表示群体中多机器人强化学习的空间交互状态。该方法采用模块化（分解）表示，其中状态的每个特征都由一个独立的学习过程处理，并将结果进行聚合。我们通过大量模拟机器人群体执行觅食任务的实验，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: From Reach to Insert: Tactile-Augmented Precision Assembly under Sub-Millimeter Tolerances
summary: High-precision assembly frequently involves tight-tolerance insertions, where even slight pose errors can cause jamming or excessive interaction forces, making robust and safe insertion policies difficult to obtain. This paper proposes a tactile-augmented two-stage method that combines Imitation Learning (IL) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) for precision insertion tasks. In the first stage, IL learns a reaching policy with position generalization that grasps the peg and brings it to the vicinity of the target region. In the second stage, RL executes the insertion and enables recovery from failures during contact-rich interactions. To better exploit tactile feedback, we introduce tactile group sampling to increase coverage of critical contact segments during training, and design a tactile critic to more accurately evaluate policy values, improving insertion performance while maintaining low contact forces. We conduct systematic experiments across five hole geometries and three clearance settings. Results show that our method substantially improves insertion performance across all settings; under the most challenging 0.05\,mm clearance, it achieves a 67\% success rate while keeping contact forces low, reducing the maximum interaction force by 60\% and torque by 44\%, thereby validating both effectiveness and safety for precision assembly.
tldr: A two-stage IL+RL method for precision peg-in-hole assembly using tactile feedback, achieving high success rates and low forces under sub-millimeter tolerances.
tldr_zh: 提出一种触觉增强的两阶段（模仿学习+强化学习）方法，用于亚毫米级公差下的精密装配，实现了高成功率与低接触力。
summary_zh: 高精度装配通常涉及紧公差插入任务，微小位姿误差即可导致卡滞或产生过量交互力，使得稳健安全的插入策略难以获取。本文提出一种触觉增强型双阶段方法，结合模仿学习与强化学习以解决精密插入任务。第一阶段通过模仿学习掌握具备位置泛化能力的趋近策略，引导机械手抓取插销并移至目标区域邻近位置；第二阶段运用强化学习执行插入操作，并在密集接触交互中实现故障恢复。为充分利用触觉反馈，我们引入触觉分组采样技术以增强训练过程中关键接触片段的覆盖度，并设计触觉评价器来更精确评估策略价值，在保持低接触力的同时提升插入性能。我们在五种孔型结构与三种间隙设置下进行系统实验，结果表明：该方法在所有设定下均显著提升插入性能；在最严苛的0.05毫米间隙条件下，取得67%的成功率且保持低接触力，最大交互力降低60%，扭矩减少44%，有效验证了精密装配场景下的性能与安全性。

title: Dream-MPC: Gradient-Based Model Predictive Control with Latent Imagination
summary: State-of-the-art model-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches either use gradient-free, population-based methods for planning, learned policy networks, or a combination of policy networks and planning. Hybrid approaches that combine Model Predictive Control (MPC) with a learned model and a policy prior to leverage the advantages of both paradigms have shown promising results. However, these approaches typically rely on gradient-free optimization methods, which can be computationally expensive for high-dimensional control tasks. While gradient-based methods are a promising alternative, recent works have empirically shown that gradient-based methods often perform worse than their gradient-free counterparts. We propose Dream-MPC, a novel approach that generates few candidate trajectories from a rolled-out policy and optimizes each trajectory by gradient ascent using a learned world model, uncertainty regularization and amortization of optimization iterations over time by reusing previously optimized actions. Our results on 24 continuous control tasks show that Dream-MPC can significantly improve the performance of the underlying policy and can outperform gradient-free MPC and state-of-the-art baselines. We will open source our code and more at https://dream-mpc.github.io.
tldr: Dream-MPC is a gradient-based model predictive control method that uses a learned world model, uncertainty regularization, and amortized optimization to improve policy performance on continuous control tasks.
tldr_zh: Dream-MPC 是一种基于梯度的模型预测控制方法，它使用学习到世界模型、不确定性正则化和摊销优化来提升连续控制任务的策略性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：
基于模型的强化学习（RL）前沿方法主要包括三种路径：采用无梯度、基于群体的规划方法、使用学习得到的策略网络，或结合策略网络与规划技术。将模型预测控制（MPC）与学习模型及策略先验相结合的混合方法，能够融合两种范式的优势，已展现出显著潜力。然而，这类方法通常依赖无梯度优化方法，在面对高维控制任务时可能带来高昂计算成本。尽管基于梯度的优化方法是一种具有前景的替代方案，但近期研究实证表明，其性能往往逊色于无梯度方法。本文提出Dream-MPC——一种新颖的框架，该方法从策略的展开过程中生成少量候选轨迹，并通过梯度上升法优化每条轨迹，其优化过程融合了以下关键技术：利用学习得到的世界模型，引入不确定性正则化，并通过复用先前已优化的动作实现优化迭代的跨时摊销。我们在24个连续控制任务上的实验结果表明，Dream-MPC能够显著提升基础策略的性能，并优于无梯度MPC方法及当前最先进的基线模型。代码及相关资源将在 https://dream-mpc.github.io 开源。

title: HDFlow: Hierarchical Diffusion-Flow Planning for Long-horizon Tasks
summary: Recent advances in generative models have shown promise in generating behavior plans for long-horizon, sparse reward tasks. While these approaches have achieved promising results, they often lack a principled framework for hierarchical decomposition and struggle with the computational demands of real-time execution, due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we introduce Hierarchical Diffusion-Flow (HDFlow), a novel hierarchical planning framework that optimally leverages the strengths of diffusion and rectified flow models to overcome the limitations of single-paradigm generative planners. HDFlow employs a high-level diffusion planner to generate sequences of strategic subgoals in a learned latent space, capitalizing on diffusion's powerful exploratory capabilities. These subgoals then guide a low-level rectified flow planner that generates smooth and dense trajectories, exploiting the speed and efficiency of ordinary differential equation (ODE)-based trajectory generation. We evaluate HDFlow on four challenging furniture assembly tasks in both simulation and real-world, where it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, we also showcase our method's generalizability on two long-horizon benchmarks comprising diverse locomotion and manipulation tasks. Project website: https://hdflow-page.github.io/
tldr: Proposes HDFlow, a hierarchical generative planning framework combining high-level diffusion for subgoal generation and low-level rectified flow for fast trajectory generation, evaluated on furniture assembly and long-horizon manipulation/locomotion tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出HDFlow，一种结合高层扩散生成子目标与低层整流流生成轨迹的分层生成规划框架，在家具装配和长视野操控/移动任务上进行评估。
summary_zh: 生成模型的最新进展在生成长时限、稀疏奖励任务的行为规划方面展现出潜力。尽管这些方法已取得显著成果，但往往缺乏层次化分解的理论框架，且由于其迭代去噪过程，难以满足实时执行的计算需求。本文提出分层扩散流（HDFlow），这是一种新颖的层次化规划框架，通过最优化结合扩散模型与修正流模型的优势，克服了单一范式生成规划器的局限性。HDFlow采用高层扩散规划器在习得的潜在空间中生成战略性子目标序列，充分发挥了扩散模型强大的探索能力。这些子目标继而引导低层修正流规划器生成平滑且密集的轨迹，该过程利用了基于常微分方程（ODE）的轨迹生成方法在速度与效率上的优势。我们在仿真与真实场景中的四项具挑战性的家具组装任务上评估HDFlow，其性能显著优于现有先进方法。此外，我们还在两个包含多样化移动与操作任务的长时限基准测试中验证了本方法的泛化能力。项目网站：https://hdflow-page.github.io/

title: Conditional Flow-VAE for Safety-Critical Traffic Scenario Generation
summary: Safety-critical scenarios are essential for the development of autonomous vehicles (AVs) but are rare in real-world driving data. While simulation offers a way to generate such scenarios, manually designed test cases lack scalability, and adversarial optimization often produces unrealistic behaviors. In this work, we introduce a conditional latent flow matching approach for scalable and realistic safety-critical scenario generation. Our method uses distribution matching to transform nominal scenes into safety-critical rollouts. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating both simulation and real-world data enables our framework to efficiently generate diverse, data-driven scenarios. Experimental results highlight that our approach is able to more consistently and realistically generate novel safety-critical scenarios, making it a valuable tool for training and benchmarking AV systems.
tldr: The paper introduces a conditional latent flow matching approach for generating safety-critical driving scenarios, using distribution matching to transform nominal scenes into realistic safety-critical rollouts.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种条件潜流匹配方法，用于生成安全关键的驾驶场景，利用分布匹配将名义场景转化为逼真的安全关键场景展开。
summary_zh: 安全关键场景对于自动驾驶汽车（AV）的发展至关重要，但在真实世界驾驶数据中却十分罕见。虽然模拟技术为生成此类场景提供了途径，但人工设计的测试用例缺乏可扩展性，而对抗性优化方法往往产生不切实际的行为。本研究提出了一种条件性潜在流匹配方法，用于生成可扩展且真实的安全关键场景。该方法利用分布匹配技术，将常规驾驶场景转化为安全关键场景的推演。此外，我们证明了通过结合模拟数据与真实世界数据，该框架能够高效生成多样化的、数据驱动的场景。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够更稳定且更真实地生成新颖的安全关键场景，这使其成为自动驾驶系统训练与性能评估的重要工具。

title: Constraint-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning Based on Dynamic Decoupled Spherical Radial Squashing
summary: When deploying reinforcement learning policies to physical robots, actuator rate constraints -- hard limits on how fast each joint can move per control step -- are unavoidable. These limits vary substantially across joints due to differences in motor inertia, power bandwidth, and transmission stiffness, creating pronounced heterogeneity that existing methods fail to handle geometrically: the per-joint feasible region forms a high-dimensional box in action-increment space, yet QP projection and spherical parameterization methods impose isotropic ball-shaped constraints, exponentially under-covering the true feasible set as heterogeneity grows. This paper proposes Dynamic Decoupled Spherical Radial Squashing (DD-SRad), which resolves this mismatch by computing a position-adaptive radius independently for each actuator, achieving tight alignment with the true per-joint feasible region. DD-SRad satisfies per-step hard constraints with probability~1, preserves well-conditioned gradients throughout training, and admits exact policy gradient backpropagation with zero runtime solver overhead. MuJoCo benchmark experiments demonstrate the highest task return at zero constraint violation -- matching the unconstrained upper bound -- with 30%--50% improvement in constraint-space coverage over spherical baselines. High-fidelity IsaacLab simulations with Unitree H1 and G1 humanoid robots confirm end-to-end optimality parameterized directly from official joint specifications, validating a systematic pathway from hardware datasheets to safe deployment.
tldr: This paper proposes DD-SRad, a reinforcement learning method that enforces actuator rate constraints to ensure safe deployment on physical robots, demonstrating superior performance and constraint satisfaction on humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DD-SRad，一种强化学习方法，用于强制执行执行器速率约束，以确保在物理机器人上的安全部署，并在人形机器人上展示了卓越的性能和约束满足能力。
summary_zh: 将强化学习策略部署到物理机器人时，执行器速率约束（即每个关节在每个控制步长内运动速度的硬性限制）是不可避免的。由于电机惯性、功率带宽和传动刚度存在差异，各关节的速率限制差别显著，这种显著的异质性使现有方法难以在几何层面有效处理：每个关节的可行域在动作增量空间中构成高维立方体，而二次规划投影和球面参数化方法施加的各向同性球形约束会随着异质性增长，以指数级程度无法覆盖真实可行集。本文提出动态解耦球面径向压缩方法（DD-SRad），通过为每个执行器独立计算位置自适应半径，解决了这种不匹配问题，实现了与真实单关节可行域的紧密贴合。DD-SRad以概率~1满足每步硬约束，在训练全程保持良好条件的梯度，并支持零运行时求解开销的精确策略梯度反向传播。MuJoCo基准实验表明，该方法在零约束违反的情况下实现了最高任务回报（与无约束上限持平），在约束空间覆盖度上较球形基线提升30%-50%。在Unitree H1和G1人形机器人上开展的高保真IsaacLab仿真验证了直接依据官方关节规格参数化的端到端最优性，为从硬件数据手册到安全部署提供了系统化技术路径。

title: Information Coordination as a Bridge: A Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Reliable Autonomous Driving Scene Understanding
summary: Reliable autonomous driving requires scene understanding that is semantically consistent across heterogeneous sensors and verifiable at the reasoning stage. However, many recent LLM-driven driving systems attach the language model as a post-processor and force it to reason over redundant or conflicting perception outputs, which can amplify hallucinated entities and unsafe conclusions. This paper proposes InfoCoordiBridge, a BEV-centric neuro-symbolic architecture that inserts an explicit coordination bridge between perception and language reasoning. InfoCoordiBridge comprises (i) a unified multi-agent perception layer that outputs typed structured facts together with modality-focused synopses, (ii) an ICA module that aligns and fuses multi-source outputs into a single SceneSummary, and (iii) an SSRE module that performs SceneSummary-grounded reasoning with verification. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that ICA preserves competitive 3D detection accuracy while substantially improving fusion consistency, reducing redundancy to below 1% and achieving about 98% attribute agreement. On NuScenes-QA and a template-aligned Waymo-QA benchmark, SSRE improves factual grounding and reduces hallucinated entity mentions compared with representative VLM and agentic baselines. Overall, by coordinating multi-sensor outputs into a single conflict-aware SceneSummary before prompting, InfoCoordiBridge prevents redundant and cross-modally inconsistent perception evidence from propagating into high-level reasoning.
tldr: Proposes InfoCoordiBridge, a BEV-centric neuro-symbolic architecture that inserts a coordination bridge between perception and LLM reasoning to improve reliability and reduce hallucinations in autonomous driving scene understanding.
tldr_zh: 提出InfoCoordiBridge，一种以BEV为中心的神经符号架构，在感知和LLM推理之间插入协调桥接，以提高自动驾驶场景理解的可靠性并减少幻觉。
summary_zh: 可靠的自动驾驶需要跨异构传感器在语义层面保持一致的场景理解，并能够在推理阶段进行验证。然而，当前许多基于大语言模型的驾驶系统将语言模型作为后置处理器，强制其在冗余或冲突的感知输出上进行推理，这容易放大幻觉实体并导致不安全结论。本文提出InfoCoordiBridge，一种以鸟瞰图为核心的神经符号架构，通过在感知与语言推理之间引入显式协调桥接模块来解决这一问题。该架构包含三个核心组件：(i) 统一的多智能体感知层，输出带类型的结构化事实及面向模态的摘要信息；(ii) 独立成分对齐模块，将多源输出对齐融合为统一的场景摘要；(iii) 场景摘要根植推理引擎，基于场景摘要进行可验证的推理。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上的实验表明，独立成分对齐模块在保持竞争力三维检测精度的同时，显著提升了融合一致性，将冗余度降至1%以下，并实现约98%的属性一致率。在NuScenes-QA和模板对齐的Waymo-QA基准测试中，场景摘要根植推理引擎相比主流视觉语言模型和智能体基线方法，有效提升了事实依据的准确性，并减少了幻觉实体的提及。总体而言，通过在大语言模型推理前将多传感器输出协调为统一的冲突感知场景摘要，InfoCoordiBridge有效避免了冗余及跨模态不一致的感知证据向高层级推理的传播。

title: InterFuserDVS: Event-Enhanced Sensor Fusion for Safe RL-Based Decision Making
summary: Autonomous driving systems rely heavily on robust sensor fusion to perceive complex envi- ronments. Traditional setups using RGB cameras and LiDAR often struggle in high-dynamic- range scenes or high-speed scenarios due to motion blur and latency. Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS), or event cameras, offer a paradigm shift by capturing asynchronous brightness changes with microsecond temporal resolution and high dynamic range. In this paper, we propose an extended architecture of the state-of-the-art InterFuser model, integrating DVS as an additional modality to enhance perception reliability. We introduce a novel token-based fusion strategy that incorporates accumulated event frames into the transformer-based backbone of InterFuser. Our method leverages the complementary nature of RGB, LiDAR, and DVS data. We evaluate our approach on the Car Learning to Act (CARLA) Leaderboard benchmarks, demonstrating that the inclusion of DVS improves the robustness of the driving agent, achieving a competitive Driving Score of 77.2 and a superior Route Completion of 100%. The results indicate that event-based vision is a promising direction for improving safety and performance in adverse lighting and dynamic conditions.
tldr: This paper enhances the InterFuser autonomous driving model by fusing event camera data with RGB and LiDAR via a novel token-based strategy, improving robustness and safety in CARLA simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过一种新颖的基于令牌的融合策略，将事件相机数据与RGB和激光雷达数据融合，增强了InterFuser自动驾驶模型，在CARLA仿真中提高了鲁棒性和安全性。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶系统高度依赖鲁棒的传感器融合以感知复杂环境。传统采用RGB相机和激光雷达的方案常因运动模糊和延迟问题，在高动态范围场景或高速场景中表现受限。动态视觉传感器（DVS），即事件相机，通过以微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围捕获异步亮度变化，实现了感知范式的革新。本文提出了一种对前沿模型InterFuser的扩展架构，通过集成DVS作为额外模态来增强感知可靠性。我们引入了一种新颖的基于令牌的融合策略，将累积事件帧整合到InterFuser的基于Transformer的骨干网络中。该方法充分发挥了RGB、激光雷达与DVS数据的互补特性。我们在Car Learning to Act（CARLA）Leaderboard基准测试中评估了所提方法，结果表明加入DVS显著提升了驾驶智能体的鲁棒性，获得了77.2分的竞争性驾驶评分和100%的优异路线完成率。这些成果表明，基于事件的视觉感知为提升恶劣光照和动态场景下的安全性与系统性能提供了重要方向。

title: From Pixels to Tokens: A Systematic Study of Latent Action Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Latent actions serve as an intermediate representation that enables consistent modeling of vision-language-action (VLA) models across heterogeneous datasets. However, approaches to supervising VLAs with latent actions are fragmented and lack a systematic comparison. This work structures the study of latent action supervision from two perspectives: (i) regularizing the trajectory via image-based latent actions, and (ii) unifying the target space with action-based latent actions. Under a unified VLA baseline, we instantiate and compare four representative integration strategies. Our results reveal a formulation-task correspondence: image-based latent actions benefit long-horizon reasoning and scene-level generalization, whereas action-based latent actions excel at complex motor coordination. Furthermore, we find that directly supervising the VLM with discrete latent action tokens yields the most effective performance. Finally, our experiments offer initial insights into the benefits of latent action supervision in mixed-data, suggesting a promising direction for VLA training. Code is available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/From_Pixels_to_Tokens.
tldr: This work systematically studies latent action supervision strategies for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, identifying the benefits of image-based vs. action-based latent actions for different task types and showing that supervising VLMs with discrete latent action tokens is most effective.
tldr_zh: 本文系统地研究了视觉-语言-动作模型中潜动作监督策略，揭示了图像基与动作基潜动作对不同任务类型的益处，并表明使用离散潜动作标记监督VLM最为有效。
summary_zh: 潜在动作作为一种中间表示形式，能够实现对异构数据集上视觉-语言-动作模型的统一建模。然而，现有基于潜在动作的视觉-语言-动作模型监督方法较为零散，缺乏系统性比较。本研究从两个维度构建了潜在动作监督的研究框架：(i) 通过基于图像的潜在动作实现轨迹正则化，(ii) 通过基于动作的潜在动作统一目标空间。在统一的视觉-语言-动作基线模型下，我们实例化并比较了四种代表性集成策略。实验结果揭示了范式与任务的对应关系：基于图像的潜在动作有利于长时程推理和场景级泛化，而基于动作的潜在动作在复杂运动协调任务中表现更优。此外，我们发现直接使用离散潜在动作标记监督视觉语言模型能获得最有效的性能。最后，实验初步揭示了潜在动作监督在混合数据训练中的优势，为视觉-语言-动作模型训练指明了有前景的研究方向。代码已开源：https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/From_Pixels_to_Tokens。

title: Right Model, Right Time: Real-Time Cascaded-Fidelity MPC for Bipedal Walking
summary: This paper presents a multi-phase whole-body model predictive control approach for bipedal walking, combining a detailed whole-body model in the near horizon with a simplified single-rigid-body model in the later prediction steps. This reduces computational complexity while retaining prediction capabilities. The resulting nonlinear optimal control problem is solved using sequential quadratic programming (SQP) in acados. Using a prior specified contact schedule and a target walking speed, the controller optimizes joint torques without depending on prior selected foot step locations. The controller is validated in MuJoCo simulation on the 18-DoF bipedal robot HyPer-2
tldr: This paper presents a multi-fidelity MPC framework for bipedal walking, combining a detailed whole-body model for near-term prediction with a simplified model for long-term prediction, enabling real-time torque optimization without pre-planned footstep locations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于双足行走的多保真度模型预测控制框架，将近期预测的详细全身模型与长期预测的简化模型相结合，实现了无需预规划落脚点的实时力矩优化。
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于双足步行的多相位全身模型预测控制方法，将近距离预测时域的精细化全身模型与远距离预测时域内的简化单刚体模型相结合。该方法在保留预测能力的同时显著降低了计算复杂度。基于预定义接触时序与目标步行速度，所构建的非线性最优控制问题通过acados中的序列二次规划算法进行求解，可在不依赖预先选定落脚点的前提下优化关节力矩。该控制器已在18自由度双足机器人HyPer-2上通过MuJoCo仿真平台完成验证。

title: Practical validation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios
summary: The representativeness of synthetic pre-crash scenarios is crucial for assessing the safety impact of Driving Automation Systems through virtual simulations. However, a gap remains in the robust evaluation of synthetic pre-crash scenarios' practical equivalence to their real-world counterparts; that is, whether they are similar enough for the intended assessment purpose. Conventional significance testing is inadequate, as it focuses on detecting differences rather than establishing practical equivalence. This study addresses the research gap by extending our previous work on a Bayesian Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE)-based equivalence testing framework by introducing a binning-based approach to define appropriate statistics and equivalence criteria. Two binning-based statistics are proposed to measure practically meaningful distributional differences between datasets in the context of safety impact assessment. The framework's applicability is demonstrated through a case study, which tests the practical equivalence of two synthetic rear-end pre-crash datasets with a previously developed reference dataset in the context of the safety impact assessment of an Automatic Emergency Braking system. The results show that the framework provides informative quantitative assessments of practical equivalence as well as diagnostic insights into the divergence of datasets. Although the demonstration focuses on rear-end pre-crash scenarios, the framework is generic and extensible to broader validation contexts, providing an interpretable and principled basis for practical equivalence assessment across diverse synthetic data applications.
tldr: The paper proposes a Bayesian Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE)-based framework with binning-based statistics to validate synthetic pre-crash scenarios for driving safety assessment.
tldr_zh: 本研究提出一种基于贝叶斯实际等价区域的框架，使用分箱统计量来验证用于驾驶安全评估的合成预碰撞场景的实用性。
summary_zh: 合成预碰撞场景的代表性对于通过虚拟仿真评估驾驶自动化系统的安全影响至关重要。然而，在稳健评估合成预碰撞场景与实际场景之间的实际等效性方面仍存在空白——即两者是否足够相似以达到预期评估目的。传统的显著性检验方法聚焦于检测差异而非建立实际等效性，因此并不适用。本研究通过扩展先前基于贝叶斯实际等效区间（ROPE）的等效性检验框架，引入基于分箱的方法来定义合适的统计量与等效标准，从而填补了这一研究空白。论文提出了两种基于分箱的统计量，用于在安全影响评估背景下度量数据集间具有实际意义的分布差异。通过案例研究验证了该框架的适用性，该案例在自动紧急制动系统的安全影响评估背景下，测试了两个合成追尾预碰撞数据集与先前开发的参考数据集之间的实际等效性。结果表明，该框架不仅提供了关于实际等效性的定量评估信息，还能对数据集间的差异进行诊断性分析。尽管演示案例聚焦于追尾预碰撞场景，但该框架具备通用性和可扩展性，可适用于更广泛的验证场景，为不同合成数据应用中的实际等效性评估提供了可解释且基于原则的方法基础。

title: Autonomous Laparoscope Control through Unified Mechanics-Based Representation of Multimodal Intraoperative Information
summary: Laparoscope-holding robots can provide surgeons with a stable laparoscopic field of view (FOV) and reduce the burden on human assistants. To maintain an ideal intraoperative FOV, the robot must continuously adjust the laparoscope pose according to intraoperative information. However, intraoperative multimodal signals, such as position, force/torque, and images, differ markedly in physical meaning and units, making it difficult to build a unified representation and to generate control commands that can be used directly for laparoscope control. To address this issue, we propose a laparoscope-holding robot control method based on unified mechanics modeling of multimodal information. First, we design mapping strategies for multiple intraoperative sources, including position, force/torque, and images, and unify them into an equivalent-wrench representation in the operational space. Then, using a task-priority scheme, we inject the wrenches into the task space and the null space, respectively, and synthesize laparoscope control commands via task-priority projection, thereby achieving consistent representation and coordinated fusion of multimodal information within a single framework. Finally, taking the intraoperative remote center of motion (RCM) position, force/torque sensor readings, and laparoscopic images as examples, we construct an RCM-constraint wrench to enforce the RCM geometric constraint and reduce the contact force at the trocar site, a laparoscope-manipulation wrench to enable compliant dragging, and an instrument-tracking wrench to achieve autonomous visual tracking of the instruments. Experiments on a surgical phantom and in vivo porcine trials demonstrate that the proposed method supports multi-task operation, including compliant laparoscope manipulation and autonomous instrument tracking, while maintaining the RCM constraint and reducing sustained trocar-site loading.
tldr: The paper proposes a mechanics-based method to unify multimodal intraoperative signals into equivalent wrenches for autonomous laparoscope control, achieving compliant manipulation and instrument tracking while respecting surgical constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于力学建模的方法，将多模态术中信息统一为等效力旋量，用于腹腔镜持镜机器人自主控制，实现顺应性操作和器械跟踪，同时满足手术约束。
summary_zh: 腹腔镜持镜机器人能为外科医生提供稳定的腹腔镜视野，并减轻人力辅助负担。为维持理想术中视野，机器人需根据术中信息持续调整腹腔镜位姿。然而，术中位置、力/力矩、图像等多模态信号在物理意义和量纲上差异显著，难以构建统一表征并生成可直接用于腹腔镜控制的指令。为解决此问题，本文提出一种基于多模态信息统一力学建模的腹腔镜持镜机器人控制方法。首先，针对位置、力/力矩及图像等多种术中信息源设计映射策略，将其统一转化为操作空间中的等效力矩表征；随后通过任务优先级策略，将各力矩分别注入任务空间与零空间，经由任务优先级投影合成腹腔镜控制指令，从而在单一框架内实现多模态信息的一致表征与协同融合。最后，以术中远程运动中心位置、力/力矩传感器读数及腹腔镜图像为例，构建远程运动中心约束力矩以强化几何约束并降低套管穿刺点接触力，设计腹腔镜操作力矩实现顺应性拖拽，建立器械追踪力矩完成器械的自主视觉跟踪。通过在手术仿真模型与活体猪实验中的验证表明，所提方法在维持远程运动中心约束、降低持续套管载荷的同时，可支持顺应性腹腔镜操作与自主器械追踪等多任务协同作业。

title: From Language to Logic: A Theoretical Architecture for VLM-Grounded Safe Navigation
summary: We propose an architecture for integrating high-level, human-provided safety rules and operator-aligned semantic preferences into autonomous robot navigation in unstructured outdoor environments. In our approach, natural-language rules are translated into Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications that guide planning and navigation during runtime. Persistent, environment-centric rules and terrain preferences are grounded into a 2D cost map, while temporally dynamic requirements are expressed as STL specifications to be monitored during runtime. We hypothesize the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for zero-shot scene understanding, enabling mapping between human instructions, semantic features, and environmental constraints. Within this framework, we construct an illustrative navigation model that is designed to satisfy a set of STL-encoded specifications and soft operator preferences through formal satisfaction metrics embedded into environmental properties and runtime monitoring.
tldr: Proposes an architecture for safe robot navigation using VLM-based scene understanding and Signal Temporal Logic for translating human language safety rules into actionable constraints.
tldr_zh: 提出一种架构，利用VLM进行场景理解，将自然语言安全规则通过信号时序逻辑转化为可执行约束，用于非结构化户外环境的机器人导航。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于非结构化户外环境中自主机器人导航的架构，该架构将人类提供的高级安全规则以及与操作员对齐的语义偏好融入其中。在我们的方法中，自然语言规则被转化为信号时序逻辑（STL）规范，以在运行时指导规划与导航。持久且以环境为中心的规则及地形偏好被映射为二维代价地图，而时序动态要求则表达为STL规范，在运行时进行监控。我们探索使用视觉语言模型（VLMs）进行零样本场景理解，实现人类指令、语义特征与环境约束之间的映射。在此框架内，我们构建了一个示例性导航模型，该模型通过嵌入环境属性与运行时监控的正式满足度度量，旨在满足一系列STL编码的规范与灵活的操作员偏好。

title: Beyond Fixed Thresholds and Domain-Specific Benchmarks for Explainable Multi-Task Classification in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Scene understanding is a vital part of autonomous driving systems, which requires the use of deep learning models. Deep learning methods are intrinsically black box models, which lack transparency and safety in autonomous driving. To make these systems transparent, multi-task visual understanding has become crucial for explainable autonomous driving perception systems, where simultaneous prediction of multiple driving behaviors and their underlying explanations is essential for safe navigation and human trust in autonomous vehicles. In order to design an accurate and cross-cultural explainable autonomous driving system, we introduce a comprehensive confidence threshold sensitivity analysis that evaluates various threshold values to identify optimal decision boundaries for different tasks. Our analysis demonstrates that traditional fixed threshold approaches are suboptimal for multi-task scenarios. Through extensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our adaptive threshold selection methodology improves F1-scores across different tasks. In addition, we introduce IUST-XAI-AD, a novel dataset consisting of 958 images with human annotations for driving decisions and corresponding reasoning. This dataset addresses the critical gap in domain-specific evaluation benchmarks for distinct driving contexts and provides a more challenging test environment compared to existing datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that confidence threshold sensitivity analysis can significantly improve model performance, while the introduction of the IUST-XAI-AD dataset reveals important insights about cross-cultural driving behavior patterns. The combined contributions of this work provide both methodological advances and practical evaluation tools that can accelerate the development of more reliable, explainable, and culturally-adaptive autonomous driving systems for global deployment.
tldr: The paper introduces an adaptive threshold selection method for multi-task explainable driving models and a novel annotated dataset, IUST-XAI-AD, to improve performance and cultural adaptability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于多任务可解释驾驶模型的自适应阈值选择方法，并引入了一个新的带标注数据集IUST-XAI-AD，以提高性能和跨文化适应性。
summary_zh: 场景理解是自动驾驶系统的关键组成部分，其实现依赖于深度学习模型。深度学习本质上是黑盒模型，在自动驾驶应用中缺乏透明度与安全性。为实现系统透明化，多任务视觉理解已成为可解释自动驾驶感知系统的核心需求——通过同时预测多种驾驶行为及其内在解释，既能保障安全导航，又能增强人类对自动驾驶车辆的信任。为设计精准且跨文化的可解释自动驾驶系统，本文提出了全面的置信度阈值敏感性分析，通过评估不同阈值来识别各任务的最优决策边界。分析表明传统固定阈值方法在多任务场景中表现欠佳。经大量实验验证，我们提出的自适应阈值选择方法在不同任务中均提升了F1分数。此外，本文还发布了IUST-XAI-AD数据集，该数据集包含958张人工标注驾驶决策及对应推理的图像，填补了特定驾驶场景领域评估基准的空白，相比现有数据集提供了更具挑战性的测试环境。实验结果表明，置信度阈值敏感性分析能显著提升模型性能，而IUST-XAI-AD数据集的引入揭示了跨文化驾驶行为模式的重要规律。本研究的综合成果既提供了方法论上的突破，也构建了实用的评估工具，有望推动面向全球部署的、更可靠、可解释且具文化适应性的自动驾驶系统发展。

title: CARD: A Multi-Modal Automotive Dataset for Dense 3D Reconstruction in Challenging Road Topography
summary: Autonomous driving must operate across diverse surfaces to enable safe mobility. However, most driving datasets are captured on well-paved flat roads. Moreover, recent driving datasets primarily provide sparse LiDAR ground truth for images, which is insufficient for assessing fine-grained geometry in depth estimation and completion. To address these gaps, we introduce CARD, a multi-modal driving dataset that delivers quasi-dense 3D ground truth across continuous sequences rich in speed bumps, potholes, irregular surfaces and off-road segments. Our sensor suite includes synchronized global-shutter stereo cameras, front and rear LiDARs, 6-DoF poses from LiDAR-inertial odometry, per-wheel motion traces, and full calibration. Notably, our multi-LiDAR fusion yields ~500K valid depth pixels per frame, about 6.5x more than KITTI Depth Completion and 10x more on average than other public driving datasets. The dataset spans ~110 km and 4.7 hours across Germany and Italy. In addition, CARD provides 2D bounding boxes targeting road-topography irregularities, enabling accurate benchmarking for both geometry and perception tasks. Furthermore, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol for road surface irregularities on CARD and benchmark state-of-the-art depth estimation models to provide strong baselines. The CARD dataset is hosted on https://huggingface.co/CARD-Data.
tldr: CARD is a multi-modal driving dataset with quasi-dense 3D ground truth, focused on challenging road topography like potholes and off-road segments, to benchmark depth estimation and perception for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: CARD 是一个多模态驾驶数据集，提供准密集的 3D 地面实况，专注于如坑洼和越野路段等具有挑战性的道路地形，用于为自动驾驶的深度估计和感知任务建立基准。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶需在多样化路面上运行以确保行驶安全。然而，当前大多数驾驶数据集采集于铺装良好的平坦道路。此外，近期驾驶数据集主要为图像提供稀疏的激光雷达真值，这不足以评估深度估计与补全任务中的细粒度几何结构。为填补这些空白，我们推出了CARD多模态驾驶数据集，该数据集在连续序列中提供准密集的3D真值，涵盖减速带、坑洞、不规则路面及越野路段等多种场景。我们的传感器套件包含同步全局快门立体相机、前后激光雷达、激光雷达惯性里程计提供的六自由度位姿、各车轮运动轨迹及完整标定数据。值得注意的是，通过多激光雷达融合技术，每帧图像可生成约50万有效深度像素点，分别达到KITTI深度补全数据集的6.5倍，以及平均超出其他公共驾驶数据集10倍。该数据集覆盖德国和意大利境内约110公里、总时长4.7小时的驾驶场景。此外，CARD专门针对路面地形不规则区域提供了2D边界框标注，为几何与感知任务建立精准的基准测试体系。我们还制定了路面不规则性的标准化评估协议，并对前沿深度估计模型进行基准测试，以提供可靠的性能基线。CARD数据集已发布于https://huggingface.co/CARD-Data。

title: The Predictive-Causal Gap: An Impossibility Theorem and Large-Scale Neural Evidence
summary: We report a systematic failure mode in predictive representation learning. Across 2695 neural network configurations trained to predict linear-Gaussian dynamics, the optimal encoder tracks the environment rather than the system it is meant to model. The mean causal fidelity -- the fraction of encoder sensitivity allocated to system degrees of freedom -- is 0.49, and only 2.5% of configurations exceed 0.70. The failure intensifies with dimension: at N=100, the optimal encoder becomes causally blind (fidelity ~10^{-8}) while achieving 92% lower prediction error than the causal representation. We prove this is not an optimization artifact but a structural property of the predictive objective: when environment modes are slower or less noisy than system modes, every minimizer of the population risk encodes the former. The set of dynamics exhibiting this predictive-causal gap is open and of positive measure in parameter space. In a nonlinear Duffing-GRU sweep, unconstrained predictors learn environment-dominant representations in 55% of tasks (95% CI 41--68%) versus 24% under operational grounding (p=2.3e-3); the median out-of-distribution MSE inflation under environment shift is 1.82x versus 1.00x. Operational grounding -- restricting the loss to system observables -- partially suppresses the gap, but causal fidelity is never recovered without an explicit system-environment boundary. The results identify the predictive-causal gap as a structural limit of learning, with implications for self-supervised representation learning, world models, and the scaling paradigm.
tldr: The paper proves a structural failure mode where predictive objectives learn environment-dominant representations instead of causal system models, degrading out-of-distribution generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文证明了一种结构性的失败模式：预测性目标会学习环境主导的表征，而不是因果系统模型，从而损害了分布外泛化能力。
summary_zh: 我们报告了预测表示学习中的一种系统性失效模式。在2695个为预测线性高斯动力学而训练的神经网络配置中，最优编码器追踪的是环境而非其本应建模的系统。平均因果保真度（即编码器对系统自由度分配敏感度的比例）仅为0.49，仅有2.5%的配置超过0.70。该失效随维度增加而加剧：当N=100时，最优编码器呈现因果盲态（保真度~10^{-8}），却比因果表示实现低92%的预测误差。我们证明这并非优化假象，而是预测目标的结构性属性：当环境模式比系统模式更慢或噪声更小时，总体风险的每个极小化器都会编码前者。展现这种预测-因果鸿沟的动力学集合在参数空间中是开集且具有正测度。在非线性Duffing-GRU参数扫描中，无约束预测器在55%的任务中（95%置信区间41-68%）学习到环境主导的表示，而操作基础模型下该比例为24%（p=2.3e-3）；环境偏移下分布外均方误差中位数膨胀系数为1.82倍，而操作基础模型为1.00倍。操作基础——将损失函数限制于系统可观测变量——可部分抑制该鸿沟，但若缺乏明确的系统-环境边界，因果保真度始终无法恢复。这些结果揭示了预测-因果鸿沟作为学习机制的结构性局限，对自监督表示学习、世界模型及规模化学习范式具有重要影响。

title: Counterfactual identifiability beyond global monotonicity: non-monotone triangular structural causal models
summary: Structural causal models provide a unified semantics for interventions and counterfactuals, but most identifiability results rely on restrictive assumptions like global monotonicity, which are often violated in embodied interaction, where the same exogenous perturbation can induce opposite responses under different contact contexts. We ask what structure still suffices once global monotonicity is dropped. We introduce non-monotone triangular structural causal models (NM-TM-SCM), which retain triangular recursion but replace global monotonicity with mechanism-wise invertibility and context-independent inverse transport. We prove that these conditions are equivalent to exogenous isomorphism and imply complete counterfactual identifiability, and we give a counterexample showing that local invertibility alone is insufficient. We instantiate the theory in CausalInverter, with triangular invertible layers, orientation gates, and transport-stability regularization. On synthetic non-monotonic mechanisms, the structural bias yields systematic counterfactual gains as non-monotonicity increases. On MuJoCo Door, our model achieves perfect event-level counterfactual recovery, lowers continuous angle error relative to a Transformer baseline, and delivers substantially more stable recovery than Transformer and conditional-flow predictors. On MuJoCo Push, where non-monotonicity is weaker, the same low-data predictors remain competitive or better, consistent with a bias-variance boundary. These results identify a broader identifiable regime between globally monotone triangular models and unconstrained black-box world models.
tldr: The paper proposes a new class of structural causal models that relax the global monotonicity assumption, enabling counterfactual identifiability in non-monotonic settings common in embodied interaction, and demonstrates the model's effectiveness on robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的结构因果模型，放宽了全局单调性假设，实现了在非单调环境（如具身交互）中的反事实可识别性，并在机器人任务上验证了模型的有效性。
summary_zh: 结构因果模型为干预与反事实提供了统一的语义框架，但大多数可识别性结果依赖于诸如全局单调性等严格假设，这些假设在具身交互中常被违反——同一外生扰动在不同接触情境下可能引发相反的反应。本文探讨在放弃全局单调性后，何种结构仍能满足要求。我们提出了非单调三角结构因果模型（NM-TM-SCM），该模型保留三角递归结构，同时将全局单调性替换为机制可逆性与情境无关的逆传输条件。我们证明这些条件等价于外生同构性，并意味着完全的反事实可识别性，同时通过反例说明仅局部可逆性是不充分的。我们基于三角可逆层、方向门控与传输稳定性正则化构建了CausalInverter模型作为该理论的具体实现。在合成非单调机制实验中，该结构偏置随着非单调性增强带来系统性的反事实性能提升；在MuJoCo Door任务中，我们的模型实现了完美的事件级反事实重建，相较于Transformer基线降低了连续角度误差，并展现出比Transformer与条件流预测器更稳定的恢复能力；在非单调性较弱的MuJoCo Push任务中，相同低数据量预测器仍保持竞争力或更优性能，符合偏差-方差边界规律。这些结果共同揭示了介于全局单调三角模型与无约束黑箱世界模型之间更广义的可识别性机制。

title: Dr-PoGO: Direct Radar Pose-Graph Optimization
summary: This paper introduces Dr-PoGO, a method for Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM) using a 2D spinning radar. Unlike cameras or lidars that require line-of-sight, millimetre-wave radars can `see' through dust, falling snow, rain, etc. Accordingly, it is a great modality for robust perception regardless of the weather conditions. While most existing radar-based SLAM methods rely on the extraction of point clouds or features to perform ego-motion estimation, Dr-PoGO leverages direct registration techniques for odometry (DRO) and loop-closure registration. An off-the-shelf radar-focused place recognition algorithm, RaPlace, provides loop-closure candidates. As RaPlace does not provide relative transformations, Dr-PoGO introduces a coarse-to-fine registration that uses visual features and descriptors to obtain an initial guess for the direct transformation refinement. The global trajectory is optimized in a pose-graph optimization. Dr-PoGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance over 300km of data in various real-world automotive environments. Our implementation is publicly available: https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_pogo.
tldr: Dr-PoGO is a robust radar-based SLAM method using direct registration for odometry and a coarse-to-fine loop closure, achieving state-of-the-art performance over 300km of automotive data.
tldr_zh: Dr-PoGO是一种稳健的雷达SLAM方法，通过直接配准进行里程计估计和由粗到精的回环检测，在超过300公里的真实汽车数据中实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了Dr-PoGO，一种基于二维旋转雷达的同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）方法。与需要视线的相机或激光雷达不同，毫米波雷达能够穿透灰尘、降雪、雨水等障碍物“观测”环境，因此无论天气条件如何，它都能实现鲁棒的环境感知。现有雷达SLAM方法大多依赖点云或特征提取来完成自运动估计，而Dr-PoGO则采用直接配准技术进行里程计计算（DRO）与回环检测。通过现成的雷达专用地点识别算法RaPlace提供回环候选帧，由于RaPlace不提供相对位姿变换，Dr-PoGO提出了一种由粗到精的配准策略，利用视觉特征与描述子获取初始变换估计，再通过直接变换优化进行精修。全局轨迹通过位姿图优化进行优化。在超过300公里的真实车载环境数据测试中，Dr-PoGO展现出先进的性能表现。我们的实现已开源：https://github.com/utiasASRL/dr_pogo。

title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Holistic Quality Assessment for 4D World Model (PhyScore)
summary:
This paper reports on the LoViF 2026 PhyScore challenge, a competition on holistic quality assessment of world-model-generated videos across both 2D and 4D generation settings. The challenge is motivated by a central gap in current evaluation practice: perceptual quality alone is insufficient to judge whether generated dynamics are physically plausible, temporally coherent, and consistent with input conditions. Participants are required to build a metric that jointly predicts four dimensions, i.e., Video Quality, Physical Realism, Condition-Video Alignment, and Temporal Consistency. Depart from that, participants also need to localize physical anomaly timestamps for fine-grained diagnosis.
  The benchmark dataset contains 1,554 videos generated by seven representative world generative models, organized into three tracks (text-2D, image-to-4D, and video-to-4D) and spanning 26 categories. These categories explicitly cover physics-relevant scenarios, including dynamics, optics, and thermodynamics, together with diverse real-world and creative content. To ensure label reliability, scores and anomaly timestamps are produced through trained human annotation with an additional automated quality-control pass.
  Evaluation is based on both score prediction and anomaly localization, with a composite protocol that combines TimeStamp_IOU and SRCC/PLCC. This report summarizes the challenge design and provides method-level insights from submitted solutions.
tldr: The paper reports a challenge for holistic quality assessment of world-model-generated videos, evaluating physical plausibility and temporal coherence beyond perceptual quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文报告了一个关于世界模型生成视频整体质量评估的挑战，旨在评估超越感知质量的物理合理性和时间一致性。
summary_zh:
本文报告了LoViF 2026 PhyScore挑战赛，这是一项针对世界模型生成视频在2D与4D生成场景下的整体质量评估竞赛。该挑战赛的设立源于当前评估实践中的一个核心缺陷：仅依赖感知质量不足以判断生成动态是否具备物理合理性、时间连贯性以及与输入条件的一致性。参赛者需构建能同时预测四个维度的评估指标，即视频质量、物理真实感、条件-视频对齐度以及时间一致性。此外，参赛者还需定位物理异常时间戳以实现细粒度诊断。

基准数据集包含由七个代表性世界生成模型生成的1,554个视频，按三个赛道（文本-2D、图像到4D、视频到4D）组织，涵盖26个类别。这些类别明确覆盖了物理相关场景，包括动力学、光学和热力学，同时包含多样化的真实世界内容与创意内容。为确保标签可靠性，评分与异常时间戳均通过训练有素的人工标注结合自动化质量控制流程生成。

评估基于评分预测与异常定位两部分，采用结合时间戳交并比与斯皮尔曼/皮尔逊相关系数的复合协议。本报告总结了挑战赛设计框架，并对参赛方案进行了方法论层面的剖析。

title: Ground4D: Spatially-Grounded Feedforward 4D Reconstruction for Unstructured Off-Road Scenes
summary: Feedforward Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as an efficient paradigm for 4D reconstruction in autonomous driving. However, in unstructured off-road scenes, its performance degrades due to high-frequency geometry, ego-motion jitter, and increased non-rigid dynamics. These factors introduce conflicting Gaussian observations across timestamps, leading to either over-smoothed renderings or structural artifacts. To address this issue, we propose Ground4D, a spatially-grounded 4D feedforward framework for pose-free off-road reconstruction. The key idea is to resolve temporal conflicts through spatially localized conditioning. Specifically, we introduce voxel-grounded temporal Gaussian aggregation, which partitions the canonical Gaussian space into spatial voxels and performs query-conditioned temporal attention within each voxel. Intra-voxel softmax normalization ensures that temporal selectivity and spatial occupancy become mutually reinforcing rather than conflicting. We furthermore introduce surface normal cues as auxiliary geometric guidance to regularize the geometry of Gaussian primitives. Extensive experiments on ORAD-3D and RELLIS-3D demonstrate that Ground4D consistently outperforms existing feedforward methods in reconstruction quality and generalizes zero-shot to unseen off-road domains. Project page and code:https://github.com/wsnbws/Ground4D.
tldr: Ground4D is a feedforward 4D reconstruction framework for unstructured off-road scenes that uses voxel-grounded temporal Gaussian aggregation and surface normal guidance to resolve conflicting observations and improve reconstruction quality.
tldr_zh: Ground4D是一种用于非结构化越野场景的前馈4D重建框架，它通过体素锚定的时间高斯聚合和表面法线引导来解决冲突观察，从而提高重建质量。
summary_zh: 前馈式高斯泼溅技术近期已成为自动驾驶领域四维重建的高效范式。然而，在非结构化越野场景中，由于高频几何结构、自运动抖动及增强的非刚性动力学等因素，其性能出现下降。这些因素导致跨时间戳的高斯观测结果相互冲突，从而产生过度平滑的渲染效果或结构伪影。为解决此问题，我们提出Ground4D——一种基于空间锚定的无位姿四维前馈式越野重建框架。其核心思想是通过空间局部条件化解决时间冲突。具体而言，我们提出体素锚定的时序高斯聚合方法，将规范高斯空间划分为空间体素，并在每个体素内执行查询条件化的时序注意力机制。体素内软最大化归一化确保时序选择性与空间占据性形成相互增强而非冲突的关系。此外，我们引入表面法线线索作为辅助几何引导，以规范化高斯基元的几何结构。在ORAD-3D和RELLIS-3D数据集上的大量实验表明，Ground4D在重建质量上持续优于现有前馈方法，并能零样本泛化至未见过的越野场景。项目页面与代码：https://github.com/wsnbws/Ground4D。

title: A Closed-Form Dual-Barrier CBF Safety Filter for Holonomic Robots on Incrementally Built Occupancy Grid Maps
summary: We present a dual-barrier control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for real-time, safety-critical velocity control of holonomic robots operating in incrementally built occupancy grid maps. As a robot explores an unknown environment, unmapped regions introduce irreducible uncertainty, since obstacle geometry beyond the explored frontier is unknown, making entry into such regions a source of collision risk, especially with front-facing sensors. To address this, we enforce two constraints: avoidance of mapped obstacles and restriction from unexplored regions. Both constraints are derived analytically from the occupancy grid's signed distance field, yielding a closed-form safety filter that requires only a small linear system solve per cycle. On resource-constrained platforms such as the Raspberry Pi, where SLAM and planning already consume significant compute, the low overhead of the proposed filter preserves resources. An adaptive gain schedule relaxes the frontier constraint in information-rich regions and tightens it in well-mapped areas, improving exploration efficiency while maintaining safety. The filter operates in velocity space as a minimally invasive correction and composes with arbitrary nominal controllers, including learning-based methods. Hardware flight experiments on a PX4-controlled quadrotor demonstrate zero collisions across multiple indoor runs.
tldr: We present a closed-form dual-barrier safety filter for real-time velocity control of holonomic robots, using CBFs to enforce both mapped obstacle avoidance and frontier restriction based on occupancy grids.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于全向机器人实时速度控制的闭式双障碍物安全滤波器，基于控制屏障函数，通过占用栅格地图同时执行已映射障碍物避障和未探索区域限制。

title: Position: Embodied AI Requires a Privacy-Utility Trade-off
summary: Embodied AI (EAI) systems are rapidly transitioning from simulations into real-world domestic and other sensitive environments. However, recent EAI solutions have largely demonstrated advancements within isolated stages such as instruction, perception, planning and interaction, without considering their coupled privacy implications in high-frequency deployments where privacy leakage is often irreversible. This position paper argues that optimizing these components independently creates a systemic privacy crisis when deployed in sensitive settings, thereby advancing the position that privacy in EAI is a life cycle-level architectural constraint rather than a stage-local feature. To address these challenges, we propose Secure Privacy Integration in Next-generation Embodied AI (SPINE), a unified privacy-aware framework that treats privacy as a dynamic control signal governing cross-stage coupling throughout the entire EAI life cycle. SPINE decomposes the EAI pipeline into various stages and establishes a multi-criterion privacy classification matrix to orchestrate contextual sensitivity across stage boundaries. We conduct preliminary simulation and real-world case studies to conceptually validate how privacy constraints propagate downstream to reshape system behavior, illustrating the insufficiency of fragmented privacy patches and motivating future research directions into secure yet functional embodied AI systems. We detail the SPINE framework and case studies at https://github.com/rminshen03/EAI_Privacy_Position.
tldr: This position paper argues for treating privacy as a lifecycle-level architectural constraint in Embodied AI, proposing a unified privacy-aware framework (SPINE) to orchestrate privacy across all system stages.
tldr_zh: 这篇立场论文主张在具身人工智能中将隐私视为生命周期的架构约束，提出了一个统一的隐私感知框架（SPINE），以协调所有系统阶段的隐私保护。

title: PhysForge: Generating Physics-Grounded 3D Assets for Interactive Virtual World
summary: Synthesizing physics-grounded 3D assets is a critical bottleneck for interactive virtual worlds and embodied AI. Existing methods predominantly focus on static geometry, overlooking the functional properties essential for interaction. We propose that interactive asset generation must be rooted in functional logic and hierarchical physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysForge, a decoupled two-stage framework supported by PhysDB, a large-scale dataset of 150,000 assets with four-tier physical annotations. First, a VLM acts as a "physical architect" to plan a "Hierarchical Physical Blueprint" defining material, functional, and kinematic constraints. Second, a physics-grounded diffusion model realizes this blueprint by synthesizing high-fidelity geometry alongside precise kinematic parameters via a novel KineVoxel Injection (KVI) mechanism. Experiments demonstrate that PhysForge produces functionally plausible, simulation-ready assets, providing a robust data engine for interactive 3D content and embodied agents.
tldr: PhysForge is a two-stage framework that generates physics-grounded 3D assets with functional and kinematic properties using a VLM as a physical planner and a physics-grounded diffusion model, supported by a large-scale annotated dataset.
tldr_zh: PhysForge 是一个两阶段框架，使用视觉语言模型作为物理规划器和基于物理的扩散模型来生成具有功能与运动学特性的、支持物理的3D资产，并有一个大规模标注数据集支持。

title: Physical Adversarial Clothing Evades Visible-Thermal Detectors via Non-Overlapping RGB-T Pattern
summary: Visible-thermal (RGB-T) object detection is a crucial technology for applications such as autonomous driving, where multimodal fusion enhances performance in challenging conditions like low light. However, the security of RGB-T detectors, particularly in the physical world, has been largely overlooked. This paper proposes a novel approach to RGB-T physical attacks using adversarial clothing with a non-overlapping RGB-T pattern (NORP). To simulate full-view (0$^{\circ}$--360$^{\circ}$) RGB-T attacks, we construct 3D RGB-T models for human and adversarial clothing. NORP is a new adversarial pattern design using distinct visible and thermal materials without overlap, avoiding the light reduction in overlapping RGB-T patterns (ORP). To optimize the NORP on adversarial clothing, we propose a spatial discrete-continuous optimization (SDCO) method. We systematically evaluated our method on RGB-T detectors with different fusion architectures, demonstrating high attack success rates both in the digital and physical worlds. Additionally, we introduce a fusion-stage ensemble method that enhances the transferability of adversarial attacks across unseen RGB-T detectors with different fusion architectures.
tldr: Proposes a physical adversarial clothing attack on visible-thermal object detectors using a non-overlapping pattern (NORP) and a spatial discrete-continuous optimization method.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种针对可见光-热成像目标检测器的物理对抗服装攻击方法，使用非重叠模式（NORP）和一种空间离散-连续优化方法。

title: Manifold Steering Reveals the Shared Geometry of Neural Network Representation and Behavior
summary: Neural representations carry rich geometric structure; but does that structure causally shape behavior? To address this question, we intervene along paths through activation space defined by different geometries, and measure the behavioral trajectories they induce. In particular, we test whether interventions that respect the geometry of activation space will yield behaviors close to those the model exhibits naturally. Concretely, we first fit an activation manifold $M_h$ to representations and a behavior manifold $M_y$ to output probability distributions. We then test the link $M_h \leftrightarrow M_y$ via interventions: we find that steering along $M_h$, which we term manifold steering, yields behavioral trajectories that follow $M_y$, while linear steering -- which assumes a Euclidean geometry -- cuts through off-manifold regions and hence produces unnatural outputs. Moreover, optimizing interventions in activation space to produce paths along $M_y$ recovers activation trajectories that trace the curvature of $M_h$. We demonstrate this bidirectional relationship between the geometry of representation and behavior across tasks and modalities. In language models, we use reasoning tasks with cyclic and sequential geometries as well as in-context learning tasks with more complex graph geometries. In a video world model, we use a task with geometry corresponding to physical dynamics. Overall, our work shows that geometry in neural representation is not merely incidental, but is in fact the proper object for enabling principled control via intervention on internals. This recasts the core problem of steering from finding the right direction to finding the right geometry.
tldr: The paper introduces manifold steering, a method for causally linking neural representation geometry to output behavior by intervening along activation-space manifolds, and demonstrates it in language models and a video world model.
tldr_zh: 论文提出流形引导方法，通过在激活空间的流形上进行干预，因果性关联神经表示几何与输出行为，并在语言模型和视频世界模型上进行了验证。

title: Gaze4HRI: Zero-shot Benchmarking Gaze Estimation Neural-Networks for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: While zero-shot appearance-based 3D gaze estimation offers significant cost-efficiency by directly mapping RGB images to gaze vectors, its reliability in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) settings remains uncertain. Existing benchmarks frequently overlook fundamental HRI conditions, such as dynamic camera viewpoints and moving targets in video. Furthermore, current cross-dataset evaluations often suffer from a complexity gap, where methods trained on diverse datasets are tested on significantly smaller and less varied sets, failing to assess true robustness. To bridge these gaps, we introduce Gaze4HRI, a large-scale dataset (50+ subjects, 3,000+ videos, 600,000+ frames) designed to evaluate state-of-the-art performance against critical HRI variables: illumination, head-gaze conflict, as well as the motion of camera and gaze target in video. Our benchmark reveals that all evaluated methods fail in at least one condition, identifying steeply-downward gaze as a universal failure point. Notably, PureGaze trained on the ETH-X-Gaze dataset uniquely maintains resilience across all other conditions. These results challenge the recent focus in the literature on complex spatial-temporal modeling and Transformer-based architectures. Instead, our findings suggest that extensive data diversity, as exemplified by the ETH-X-Gaze dataset, serves as the primary driver of zero-shot robustness in unconstrained environments, while resilience-enhancing frameworks, such as PureGaze's self-adversarial loss for gaze feature purification, provide a substantial further improvement. Ultimately, this study establishes a rigorous benchmark that provides practical guidelines for practitioners as well as reshaping future research. The dataset and codes are available at https://gazeforhri.github.io.
tldr: The paper introduces Gaze4HRI, a large-scale video dataset and benchmark to rigorously evaluate zero-shot 3D gaze estimation methods under Human-Robot Interaction conditions, finding that data diversity and feature purification are key to robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Gaze4HRI，一个用于在具身人机交互条件下严格评估零样本3D视线估计方法的大规模视频数据集和基准，发现数据多样性和特征提纯是实现鲁棒性的关键。

title: 3D Printing of Passively Actuated Self-Folding Robots with Integrated Functional Modules
summary: We introduce an elastic-driven self-folding approach that fabricates robots directly from flat 3D-printed conductive PLA nets. Elastic bands routed through printed hooks store energy that folds the sheet into programmed 3D geometries, while the flat state allows accurate placement of electronics and magnets before deployment. The same substrate doubles as electrodes for capacitive touch and supports a reusable platform I/O palette with Hall sensors and eccentric rotating mass (ERM) motors for docking detection and vibration actuation. We also derive a closed-form folding model that balances hinge stiffness with elastic band moment to predict equilibrium fold angles; experiments validate the model and yield a design map linking hinge thickness, band size, and hook spacing to target angles. Using this workflow we realize multiple polyhedral modules and demonstrate three applications: a cube that highlights the potential of self-folding for scalable modular robot collectives, a deployable gripper, and a tendon-driven finger. The method is low cost, stimulus-free, and integrates actuation and sensing.
tldr: A 3D printing and elastic self-folding method is introduced to fabricate robots from flat sheets, with integrated electronics and a derived folding model, demonstrated for modular robots, a gripper, and a finger.
tldr_zh: 介绍了一种基于3D打印和弹性自折叠的机器人制造方法，从平面片材制造机器人，集成了电子器件，并推导了折叠模型，应用于模块化机器人、抓取器和手指。

title: AI-Aided Advancements in Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Navigation
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) have become indispensable for deep-sea exploration, spanning critical scientific research and commercial applications. The rapid attenuation of electromagnetic waves renders satellite radio signals unavailable, while the dynamic unpredictability of the marine environment presents formidable navigation challenges. This chapter explores recent advancements in AI-aided AUV positioning, specifically focusing on advanced sensor fusion architectures that integrate inertial navigation systems with Doppler velocity logs and cameras. Beyond traditional model-based filtering, we examine the transformative emergence of AI-driven learning approaches in enhancing inertial dead-reckoning tasks and adaptive fusion algorithms. By addressing these recent milestones, this chapter provides a comprehensive roadmap for achieving the high-precision navigation essential for autonomous underwater missions.
tldr: This chapter reviews AI-aided navigation for autonomous underwater vehicles, focusing on sensor fusion and learning methods to improve inertial dead-reckoning and positioning.
tldr_zh: 本章回顾了人工智能辅助的自主水下航行器导航技术，重点关注传感器融合和学习方法，以改进惯性航位推算和定位精度。

title: FlowDIS: Language-Guided Dichotomous Image Segmentation with Flow Matching
summary: Accurate image segmentation is essential for modern computer vision applications such as image editing, autonomous driving, and medical image analysis. In recent years, Dichotomous Image Segmentation (DIS) has become a standard task for training and evaluating highly accurate segmentation models. Existing DIS approaches often fail to preserve fine-grained details or fully capture the semantic structure of the foreground. To address these challenges, we present FlowDIS, a novel dichotomous image segmentation method built on the flow matching framework, which learns a time-dependent vector field to transport the image distribution to the corresponding mask distribution, optionally conditioned on a text prompt. Moreover, with our Position-Aware Instance Pairing (PAIP) training strategy, FlowDIS offers strong controllability through text prompts, enabling precise, pixel-level object segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches both with and without language guidance. Compared with the best prior DIS method, FlowDIS achieves a 5.5% higher $F_β^ω$ measure and 43% lower MAE ($\mathcal{M}$) on the DIS-TE test set. The code is available at: https://github.com/Picsart-AI-Research/FlowDIS
tldr: A dichotomous image segmentation method using flow matching and text prompts for precise object segmentation, with state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 一种利用流匹配和文本提示的二值图像分割方法，用于精确对象分割，在基准测试中取得最先进的性能。

title: Koopman Identification of Nonlinear Systems via Reservoir Liftings
